alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend latency rose only 2-5x, against 31-45x at recommendationservice (E1). That fits propagation from its slow downstream call, not an origin.
The all-services ranking shows no productcatalogservice deviation (E1). The extra latency appears on calls into recommendationservice, not in work it does downstream (E2).

Its own span self-time is flat (1.0->1.02ms), and no cpu or memory metrics appear among the top deviations (E1, E2). Saturation would slow its own processing; this delay sits outside it, typical of injected network delay.

proposed_fix.description: Check recommendationservice's pod/network path for injected latency (e.g. a tc netem qdisc or a chaos experiment) and remove it. Then confirm that caller-observed latency into recommendationservice returns to its ~4ms baseline and that frontend latency recovers.
